subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository trust `openai/codex-action@52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` and the related revised action SHAs in the existing secret-bearing workflows?
rationale: This is an intentional supply-chain and credential-boundary decision; a mechanical Dependabot bump cannot establish that the revised third-party action code preserves the repository's required privilege and secret-handling posture.

options.title: Audit and approve the pins
options.body: Review the upstream revisions and attach redacted evidence from the affected credentialed workflow paths before merging.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Merge only independently reviewed low-risk action pins and keep the Codex, token, release, and publishing action revisions in a separately audited PR.

options.title: Pause this update
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the action revisions cannot receive a timely security review.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the pins
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions and attach redacted evidence from the affected credentialed workflow paths before merging.
